thread:
zoe (Design): Quick follow-up from the design review: the new smoothing is visually pleasing but it's hiding very short spikes that ops care about. testers missed 8-15s blips. we should add a non-invasive preserve option per-panel rather than changing the global default.

matt (PM): Strong +1. Suggest a lightweight "preserve short peaks" toggle in the panel controls. Keep default smoothing as-is but make preservation opt-in.

arya (Viz Eng): I prototyped an adaptive-preserve mode: MAD-based threshold + prominence check + cap on markers. config snippet:
```
preserve_mode: adaptive
mad_factor: 2.7
prominence: auto
max_preserved: 6
```
It keeps sub-30s spikes on latency/error traces and ignores single-sample noise.

cam (A11y): Accessibility notes: preserved markers must be keyboard-focusable and expose an aria-label like "preserved spike +120ms at 14:03 UTC". don't rely on color: use shape + pattern variants for colorblind palettes. current orange dot fails contrast on dark theme.

zoe (Design): Copy idea: toggle label = "Show short spikes". Legend behavior: compact two-line layout (name + microstate) with microstate collapsed behind a small chevron. show a tiny "spike" badge only when preserved spikes exist.

matt (PM): Important: thresholds should be metric-aware (percent vs absolute). default to `auto` but allow manual override per-panel. also add telemetry: preserved_spikes_count per panel for tuning.

arya (Viz Eng): Implementation notes: prefer canvas rendering for markers to avoid DOM bloat; cap markers and keep debug overlay for QA showing preserved indices. two-line legend keeps layout tidy.

cam (A11y): Keyboard shortcut suggestion: press "P" when a chart is focused to toggle preservation. tooltip "P: toggle short-spike preservation" and visible focus ring. ensure screen reader announces "preservation on/off".

ui-bot: Mock uploaded: https://redwood.design/mockups/adaptive_preserve_v1.png

zoe (Design): I'll update the component spec (copy, responsive legend, focus rules) and open a PR with QA checklist: keyboard nav, screen reader labels, contrast checks, legend truncation, metric-adaptive thresholds, and marker cap stress tests.
